content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Digital products

Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle offer convenience—until they don’t. Stripe gives you APIs, dashboards, and payment links. But it requires a supported bank account. PayPal offers global reach but freezes accounts without warning. Gumroad simplifies product delivery but takes a cut and depends on Stripe. Lemon Squeezy and Paddle promise ease but restrict access based on geography. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, like COREMERCH’s Edge Commerce Stack, offers ownership. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages host your store. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend logic. Supabase or Google Sheets store orders. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 delivers files. NOWPayments verifies crypto payments. No platform owns your data. No subscription fees. No geographic restrictions. You deploy once, own forever. The tradeoff? You manage deployment. The reward? Infrastructure sovereignty.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe and PayPal exclude countries based on regulatory risk, currency instability, or political factors. Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Zimbabwe—all blocked. Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle depend on Stripe or PayPal, so their restrictions apply. These platforms prioritize compliance over access. Sovereign commerce infrastructure bypasses this. It’s built on open protocols. GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase—these tools don’t care about your country. NOWPayments processes 300+ cryptocurrencies with no KYC. Your buyers don’t need accounts. Payments confirm on-chain. The system works anywhere internet exists. It’s not a workaround. It’s a structural alternative. You’re not begging for access. You’re building your own infrastructure. The tradeoff? You handle setup. The reward? Permanent access.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Stripe and PayPal take 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction. They hold funds for days or weeks. Gumroad adds its own fee on top. Lemon Squeezy and Paddle charge monthly subscriptions. Sovereign commerce infrastructure cuts the middlemen. NOWPayments charges 0.5% per transaction. No monthly fees. No hidden costs. Payments confirm on-chain within minutes. Recommended networks like BSC, Solana, and TRON keep transaction fees under $0.10. The tradeoff? You educate buyers on crypto. The reward? Instant payments, lower fees, global reach. Your buyers don’t need bank accounts. They send crypto. You deliver the product. No platform delays. No geographic restrictions. The system is yours.
Stripe locks out creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, and more. Sovereign infrastructure doesn’t.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle own your data. They control your access. They can shut you down. Sovereign commerce infrastructure gives you ownership. You deploy the stack. You own the code. You control the data. Automation is built in. Payment confirms on-chain. Webhook triggers product delivery. No manual intervention. File delivery is instant. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 hosts your files. Buyers download directly. No platform dependency. The tradeoff? You manage deployment. The reward? Full control. No platform can block you. No subscription can expire. Your infrastructure is permanent. Your business is sovereign.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If you’re in a Stripe-restricted country, sovereign commerce infrastructure is your best option. COREMERCH’s Edge Commerce Stack deploys in 48 hours. Cloudflare Pages hosts your store. Cloudflare Workers handle backend logic. Supabase stores orders. NOWPayments verifies payments. Five products loaded. SPF/DKIM/DMARC configured. End-to-end tested. 30-day support. If you’re in a supported country but want ownership, this stack still wins. No platform fees. No geographic restrictions. Lifetime access. If you’re unsure, start with The Sovereign Blueprint. Full docs, source code, scaling playbook. Deploy yourself or hire a developer. The choice is clear. Rent infrastructure, or own it. Depend on platforms, or build your own. The future is sovereign.
